from pathlib import Path
path=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-da54e03c.py')
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Locate the straight 2-colored guide line.
    guide_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    guide_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    guide_is_row = guide_row is not None
    if guide_is_row:
        axis, guide = 0, guide_row
    elif guide_col is not None:
        axis, guide = 1, guide_col
    else:
        return g
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] != 4 and g[r][c] != 2]
    if not pts:
        return g
    lo = min(p[axis] for p in pts)
    hi = max(p[axis] for p in pts)
    # Slide the colored object toward the guide until it touches it.
    direction = 1 if lo > guide else -1
    shift = (guide + 1 - lo) if direction == 1 else (guide - 1 - hi)
    moved = [(r + (shift if axis == 0 else 0), c + (shift if axis == 1 else 0), g[r][c]) for r, c in pts]
    for r, c in pts:
        g[r][c] = 4
    for r, c, color in moved:
        g[r][c] = color
    trail = min(p[axis] for p in moved) - 1 if direction == 1 else max(p[axis] for p in moved) + 1
    if axis == 0 and 0 <= trail < h:
        g[trail] = [8] * w
    elif axis == 1 and 0 <= trail < w:
        for r in range(h):
            g[r][trail] = 8
    return g
'''
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(path),'exec'),globals())
